notes: Draft configuration: The operator Combined course plan identifies the complete western technical circuit, the large eastern circuit and their northern connection. The independently mapped full closed raceway follows these branches and excludes the facility access and paddock roads. Its unchanged public source-node length is 4772.2 m against the catalogue scalar of 4877 m. The source centreline remains a draft and does not certify fine chicane alignment or the advertised race distance. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4772.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
